svg.title: FIG 03 · release flow
svg.desc: Line drawing of the release flow as five checkpoint gates on a track: train (DVC revision, git SHA), export (ONNX to TensorRT, parity within 1.2e-5), benchmark (p50, p95, p99), deterministic A/B gate, promote. A release token passes through; now and then the A/B gate rejects a regression and it rolls back.
svg.text: every model release passes five gates · a regression never reaches production
